title: Chapter 955
paragraphs: Chapter 955
Episode 235. Zito (4)
I really hate this-!
Zito yelled out once more.
He trembled like the day when he was attacked mentally by Ayula. The idea that his enemies had suddenly become so harmonious and combined their powers against him was way over the top.

[It's so annoying, really. What the heck are you guys? Suddenly combining forces like protagonists in a boy's novel, do you think I was born in pain to see such a sight? Isn't it the usual development to have a bloody fight when the three of us are in conflict?]
"You're too loud."
Zzzeong-! Crunch!
Elona's magic power exploded Zito once more. The sounds of flesh, blood, and organs bursting spread, and Elona, with her eyes wide open, pulled up her magic power again.
That magic power quickly formed a gigantic sphere like the sun in the sky.
It was not just one. There were easily more than ten spheres covering the sky and targeting Zito. Every time Elona swung her staff downward, a sphere fell to the ground.
[Kwaaaak!]
Every time a sphere fell, Zito lost his physical body once.
Even if he quickly formed a new body, it was only twisted and torn by the pull and push left by the exploding sphere.

Even if he moved to a faraway place and formed a body there, it was the same. A new sphere had already fallen where Zito's body would appear, and in every place where multiple bodies were formed, there was Elona's magical power.
Jin had never seen a wizard who could use that much magical power.
The destruction shown by Phaelito's Heavenly Destruction in the Holy Land was shocking, but even that seemed paltry compared to the nameless grand magic that Elona was now unfolding.
[Wow shit, is that power something that a human can wield? At this rate, that seems more dangerous than me.]
"Didn't I tell you to shut up?"
The magic spheres began to rotate, transforming into cubes.

Then, a whirlpool opened in the middle of the empty space, and Zito was incessantly sucked into it. The formed bodies tried their best to escape but were swallowed up while their arms and legs were torn apart, and the empty space was warping as a whole, turning like a massive dough.
In just a few minutes, Elona had used such an immense amount of magic power, but she showed no signs of fatigue.
Rather, her attitude seemed to imply that this was just the beginning.
'So, this is what it meant when they said she alone held more than half the total power of the Jipels a thousand years ago.'
Elona is a magician who can destroy a continent just by swinging her wand a few times.
A thousand years ago, hardly anyone recognized her as human. In those days, to people, Elona was perceived as an avatar of disaster and destruction, like the witch Heluram.
"Kheeiiiak!"
Zito screamed. Since forming a human-shaped flesh was meaningless, he was moving the entire void.
A fist as big as a castle was falling from the middle of the sky. That fist struck the whirlwind unfolded by Elona, crumpled, and scattered purple flesh in all directions.
The whirlwind was also scattering. The rotating magic cubes were slowing down like a machine with severed power.
"So a god is still a god? Breaking this with such a simple method."
"If it weren't for our Jin, you would have died without being able to resist, now that you can hold out a bit, your mouth seems bored?"
"I'm not just holding out, my mind is very clear."
"Have you ever thought that's because our Jin is taking your pain on your behalf? Very selfish."
At those words, Elona burst into a snicker.
"It feels like this to rely on someone stronger than me."
Fighting with a stronger person and relying on him.
Of course, it was a feeling Elona had never experienced, either a thousand years ago or now. She was always the strongest, and people always relied on her.
"It might seem selfish. But what about it? The person who actually protects me is okay with it, what right do you have to talk such nonsense?"
Another fist was covering Jin and Elona.
Before the fist could touch, Elona swung her wand upward as if to strike with a sword. Then, the magical power shot up sharply like a sword's blade, splitting Zito's fist in half.
She did not use the unique cutting power of wind magic or light magic. Elona simply compressed her magical power to an endless extent and imitated the swords of the knights.
Even the imitation had the power comparable to the destruction spell.
In the brief gap that arose, Zito did not miss it and formed a flesh behind Elona's back to strike with a thorny axe.
"Zito, what would happen if it were close combat?"
Zito must have thought Elona couldn't avoid it.
Surely she would block with a protective shield, so he planned to concentrate the power on the thorny axe and infiltrate the spikes into the shield in one breath.
However, the moment he swung the thorny axe, Zito suddenly felt his body slowing down. Just like the day he faced the god of time, Olta, in the past.
'This crazy...!'
"Of course, Elona does not possess the power of time that Olta has.
Yet, Zito's movements were slowing due to magic. The magic, densely compressed around Elona, was blocking Zito like water.
The axe, which should have fallen as quickly as thunder, continued to descend somewhat slowly. Elona responded leisurely, parrying the axe with her staff.
'Runcandel's swordsmanship...!?'
An unconventional form and method, just a brutish swordsmanship based on a blessed physique.

Elona's close combat was unmistakably similar to Runcandel's. Runcandel was the one who fought the most with Elona a thousand years ago, so naturally, she mimicked their swords. Their swords were the best after all.

This would be impossible for a typical mage. Even if they were an extraordinarily gifted knight rather than a mage, they could not imitate them just based on the experience of having fought a lot with Runcandel.
But Elona was implementing Runcandel's physicality using extreme magic.
'She's mitigating all the strain on the body and explosive movements with magic. I didn't think that would be possible. It's not an easy task, even for me, who has both heart and brain.'
Jin had never seen more complex and inefficient use of magic in his life. But for Elona, it was as comfortable as breathing.
Kaang-! The staff and the axe clashed. Elona moved like a top-tier Runcandel, even managing to pressure Zito back.
The staff, moving like a sword, was flexible yet destructive, swift yet meticulous.
In the past, she had broken down numerous Runekandels this way. The Runekandels, who had barely fought their way into range, had no choice but to despair at her close combat skills.
Since all the pain from contact was borne by Jin, she was able to move much more freely.
There was no need to save energy like Jin. Saving energy was a necessity only for those lacking power.
'At this rate, I'll be able to find a chance to unleash the Sun Splitter.'
Although more energy was depleted than expected in protecting her before she accepted the proposal, it wasn't a problem.
Jin was concentrating on recovery while keeping an eye on the battle.
Even though Elona seemed to be overwhelming Zito now, in fact, their fight was a meaningless war of attrition.
Two beings with infinite power were simply marking each other.
Time was still on Zito's side. The only reason Elona could fight like this was because Jin was enduring all the pain.
So, if Jin collapsed, it would be the end for Elona as well.
'Once... I only need to cut him once.'
Elona was also aware of this fact."
"'If I was at my peak a thousand years ago, I feel like I could have obliterated Zito on my own, without needing Jin... Now, it's challenging. If Jin can't finish this, I'll be in danger too.'
But she was not anxious.
Despite feeling Jin's breath quickening, Elona was confident that he would certainly pull through.
When she told Zito that Jin was stronger than herself, she meant it. Not just in terms of power or combat prowess, fundamentally, Jin was a person who was incomparably resilient than she was.
'If such a person is the friend of the ruler... the ruler will surely find what they've lost.'

[Argh! Can't you just die? You're more annoying than I thought? It seems like you're also a remnant of the Sun God, so shouldn't we be on the same team? If I am the embodiment of the pain the Sun God felt, then you seem like the embodiment of the Sun God's desire to destroy.]
"Perhaps. But unlike you, Zito, I don't want to live a life bound by fate. Have you ever thought about how ugly and coarse you are?"

[Huh, haha. Talk like that to me when you're not smelling of human blood. Just how many humans have you killed all this time? Seems like it's in the hundreds of millions. We're similar, Elona Zipfel. Even if you're lucky enough to survive today, you'll end up contributing the most to the destruction of the world.]
"Then someone will stop me. Just like Jin is trying to cut you down now."
At that moment, Jin switched his sword.
Golden energy and spirit gathered around Bradamante. He was ready. Zito was too distracted by Elona to properly interfere with Jin.
'This sword...!'
Elona's eyes widened. The moment the light radiating from Jin colored the void, memories that had been forgotten rushed in like a flood.
These were not the dark memories stirred by Zito.
What came to Elona's mind now was the shining will and belief of the people who tried to protect the world at that time.
It was the memory of the moment when she decided to leave Zipfel, guided by their light.
[Ah, crap. So it ends up like this.]
Runcandel's Magic Sword Number 5
Sun Splitter
As Jin stepped forward to swing his sword, a huge and dense shadow suddenly formed in the middle of the battlefield.
It was Zito's true form. The power of the Sun Splitter had forced the form that Zito had been hiding to be revealed.
Jin swung Bradamante powerfully towards Zito's true form.
Beyond Zito's void, the entire hell was dyed in golden energy in an instant.
